arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، إذَا ذُكِرَ الأبْرَارُ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ مَا اخْتَلَفَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ صَلاَةً لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ مَدَدُهَا، وَلاَ يُحْصَى عَدَدُهَا صَلاَةً تَشْحَنُ الْهَوَاءَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih, idhā dhukira al-abrār waṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi mā ikhtalafa allaylu wan-nahāru ṣalātan lā yanqaṭiʿu madaduhā walā yuḥṣā ʿadaduhā ṣalātan tashḥanu al-hawā
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household when the pious are mentioned and bless Muhammad and his Household as long as night and day come and go with a blessing whose replenishment is never cut off and whose number cannot be counted, a blessing that will fill up the air
and crowd the earth and the heaven!

arabic_text: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَرْضَى، وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ بَعْدَ الرِّضَا صَلاَةً لا حَدَّ لَها وَلاَ مُنْتَهَى يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
transliteration: ṣalla allāhu ʿalayhi ḥattá yarḍá wa ṣalla allāhu ʿalayhi wa ālihi baʿda al-riḍā ṣalātan lā ḥadda lahā walā muntaḥā yā arḥama r-rāḥimīn
english_text: God bless him until he is well pleased and God bless him and his Household after good pleasure with a blessing that has neither bound nor utmost limit! O Most Merciful of the merciful!
